tei:div.tei:p: 1) ༄༅/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog ster bzhugs// 2)

skyabs sems ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus he ru kar// mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi// srid 'gro nyam nga'i gdung ba las// bsal phyir bla med mchog sems bskyed// yan lag bdun ni/ dpal ldan bla ma he ru kar// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags// yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs byang chub snying por bsngo// bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐/ gdod nas 'khor 'das gnyis med la// bgegs dang bar chad ming yang med// gzung 'dzin rnam par rtog pa'i bgegs// chos dbyings skye med klong du dengs/ sum bha ni/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ 'od gsal ye shes snying po'i rtsal// dag mnyam bde ba chen po la// mtshan 'dzin 'khrul rtog rang sar yal// rig stong mtshams las 'da' ma byed// badz+ra rak+ṣaḥ byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings gnyug ma'i gzhal yas nas// dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs// thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs// gnas 'dir byin phob dngos grub stsol/ badz+ra a be sha ya āḥ mchod rlabs ni/ hūm̐/ stong nyid dbyings las snying rje'i rtsal// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 3)rol sprin// chos dbyings rgyas par 'gengs ba yis// 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ tshogs zhing bskyed pa ni/ āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med// 'gag med rtsal las snang yul kun// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi zhing*// ngo mtshar bkod pa lhun grub dbus// gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams// phyag g.yas thod rnga g.yon gri gug /rus pa'i rgyan drug dor stabs can// mdun mkhar 'ja' zer thig le'i klong*// pad+ma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka /dmar gsal khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams// phyed skyil rus pa'i rgyan drug spras// rdo rje dril bus phyag rgya sgyur// thod skam dbu rgyan stag sham can// spyi bor kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi dbang*// rgyal ba'i myu gu 'jigs med gling*/

gdod ma'i mgon po klong chen pa// kun kyang he ru ka pa'i chas// rig rtsal rol pa thogs med sgyur// 'khor du mdo sgyu sems phyogs dang*// sgrub sde bka' brgyad 4) la sogs pa'i// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// bka' sdod dam can sprin ltar 'khrigs// gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan// de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul kun// mdun mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs// dgongs shig dam ldan bu la dgongs// gsang gsum byin nus snying la phob// ngo mtshar rtags mtshan myur du ston/ e h+ya hi pheṃ pheṃḥ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha// gzhi rgyud rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i// dkyil 'khor chen por rtag bzhugs la/ dgongs pa'i rtsal chen snying la sbor/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐/ rang dang gnyis su med pa'i lha// ye nas ye sangs rgyas pa la// tha dad mtshon bya'i yul las 'das// dbyer med rtogs pas brda phyag 'tshal// na mo na ma hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ tshogs drug yul gyi rtsal snang kun// kun tu bzang po'i rgyan du shar// 'dod yon ma spangs phyag rgya che// blang dor 'dzin zhain bral bas mchod/ 5) badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+da pañtsa rak+ta bha liṃ ta khā hiḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po'i ye shes rtsal// dgongs brda snyan brgyud sprul ba'i gar// sna tshogs snang yang ngo bor gcig ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa bar bstod/ dzapra ni/ thugs kar skye med 'od gsal klong*// rang byung rdo rje'i 'bru drug shar// blo 'das chos sku'i dgongs pa la// cog bzhag chen po'i ngang nas bzla/ 'a a ha sha sa maḥ bzlas pa'i tshad ni bye ba bcu/ 'bring la bye ba/ thams ya/ rjes la tshogs byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes rtsal las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ// 'phros pas ma dag dngos 'dzin sbyangs// brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten ma lus pa// ye shes tshogs kyi rol par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ

spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings na bzhugs pa chos kyi sku// gzugs sku ye shes 'khor lo'i sprin// gang 'dul gdul bya'i ngaur snang ba'i// sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams gshegs// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa ni// ye shes chen po'i bcud du smin// gsang gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgya che// bsal bzhag bral ba'i ngang du bzhes// ga ṇa tsakra 6) pū dza hoḥ bshags pa ni/ ma rig gzung 'dzin rlabs kyi g.yos// rang gnas ye shes rang zhal bsgribs// glo bur bag chags sems dang bcas// gzhi grol chos dbyings klong du bshags/ badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ sgral bstab ni/ tshogs brgyad rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor kun/ /blo 'das 'od gsal dbyings su bsgral/ khyad chos drug ldan he ru ka'i// thig le nyag cig klong du bstab// rū tra sarba ha la pañtsa pū dza khā hiḥ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba// dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging laṅka// 'bar ma ma sring sa bdag sogs// lhag gtor 'di bzhes phrin las sgrubs/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta khā hiḥ bskul pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma g.yel bla ma he ru ka /bdag cag mos pa'i bu la dgongs// thugs rje'i mthu rtsal stobs bskyed la// byin rlabs ye shes snying la phob/ chad tho ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// ma mgon gza' rdor dregs pa'i tshogs// mchod gtor 'di bzhes phrin las sgrubs/ brtan ma ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma'i bka' sdod bod khams skyong*// tshe ring ma sogs brtan ma'i tshogs// bshal chu'i gtor ma 7) 'di longs la// mtha' dmag gdug pa'i 'tshe ba srungs/ ma ma hring hring ba ling+ta khā hiḥ rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog kun// gzhi rdzogs bar mtshams med par mnan// 'od gsal gnyug ma'i rgya yis thebs// blo 'das dgongs pa'i sa la skyol/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ mchod cing bstod la dngos grub blang ba ni/

ho/ rig 'dzin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbyings// thugs rjes dgongs pa'i rtsal phyung la// snang ba bzhi yi 'od gsal sprin// tshe 'di nyid la mthar phyin mdzod// ma hā su kha sid+dhi hoḥ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ ka dag chos zad dgongs pa la// tshogs brgyad 'khrul pa'i nyes tshogs kun// 'od gsal dbyings su dag nas kyang*// dgongs pa'i ye shes mngon gyur mdzod/ /yig brgya brjod/ bsdu ldang ni/ ho/ gzhi snang lhun grub rol pa'i rtsal// gzhi dbyings gnyug ma'i dbyings su thim/ ma 'gags thugs rje'i rol pa las// rnam grol gzugs sku'i rol par shar/ bsngo smon ni/ ho/ zag bcas zag med dge rtsa kun/ gzhon du bum sku'i klong du bsngo// 'khrul pa'i rdzun ris dbyings su nub/ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs 8)gyur cig /bkra shis ni/ ho/ bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin ltar 'khrigs// yi dam dngos grub char chen 'bebs// mkha' 'gros bu bzhin bskyangs nas kyang*// mchog thun grub pa'i bkra shis shog ces pa'ang smrar btsun zung dang ni gu bcas kyi ngor dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
